name: wsb-mcp
description: Run risky commands in a disposable, offline Windows Sandbox guest.
long_description: Lets an AI agent running under a restricted Windows account start, query and stop a fresh Windows Sandbox (networking disabled) and run commands in it, with optional read-only input and writable output folders. This bundle contains the client side (proxy). It needs the broker set up once on the same machine by the interactive user: 'wsb-mcp setup --agent <account> --root <folder>' (see the README). Requires Windows 11 24H2 or later with Windows Sandbox enabled.

tools.name: sandbox_start
tools.description: Start a fresh, offline Windows Sandbox guest, optionally mapping an input and an output folder.

tools.name: sandbox_exec
tools.description: Run a command line in the guest and return its exit code.

tools.name: sandbox_status
tools.description: Report whether the sandbox is running and which folders are mapped.

tools.name: sandbox_stop
tools.description: Stop and discard the sandbox guest.
